description: This file defines wrappers for ABI (Application Binary Interface) differences, including template classes for comparing elements of ABI representations, and utility functions for filtering symbols. It acts as an interface for differences checking in the header comparison tool, involving various data structures and helper classes from the 'repr' namespace.

classes.name: DiffWrapper
classes.description: A template class that wraps ABI difference helper functionalities for specific types, providing diff dumping capabilities and utilizing internal helper functions.

methods.name: bool IgnoreSymbol(const T * element,const std::set<std::string> & ignored_symbols,F func)
methods.description: A utility function template to determine if a symbol should be ignored based on a set of ignored symbols, using a provided function to derive the symbol name.

methods.name: DiffWrapper::DiffWrapper
methods.description: Constructor for the DiffWrapper class, initializing the helper with relevant ABI elements, diff policies, type caches, and ignored linker set keys.

methods.name: DiffWrapper::DumpDiff
methods.description: Method to perform the difference dump for the wrapped ABI element, specifying the kind of diff to generate.
